name: mirage
text: v1.0.123 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.123 . It shrinks the bets file: settled bets older than 3 days lose their heavy price snapshot once GitHub has their day (the figures you see stay). The phone does this on its next history save, so the file should drop on its own after you update and the app runs a few minutes. I can't measure your phone's start time from here; send a new diagnostics report after and I'll check it.
